proposals.before: Ouyang Xuan once wrote in praise of Liu Yin's portrait: "The ardor of the micro-dot, yet with the joy of bathing at Yi above in the wind and rain;
proposals.after: Ouyang Xuan once wrote in praise of Liu Yin's portrait: "With Dian's unrestrained spirit, yet with the joy of bathing at the Yi in the wind and rain;
proposals.reason: 微點 alludes to Zeng Dian (曾點), not a literal micro-dot; the portrait praise compares Liu Yin to Dian's free spirit in the Analects.

proposals.before: Ouyang Xuan once praised Yin's portrait, saying: "The wildness of the micro-dot, yet with the joy of bathing at Yi above the wind;
proposals.after: Ouyang Xuan once praised Yin's portrait, saying: "With Dian's wildness, yet with the joy of bathing at the Yi above the wind;
proposals.reason: Same Zeng Dian allusion mistranslated as micro-dot in the literal English.

proposals.before: He also once said to scholars: "Zhu Xi's achievement in the Way through inquiry and learning is the greater part, while Lu Xiangshan Jing focused chiefly on honoring moral nature.
proposals.after: He also once said to scholars: "Zhu Xi's achievement in the Way through inquiry and learning is the greater part, while Lu Xiangshan focused chiefly on honoring moral nature.
proposals.reason: Literal English wrongly appends Jing after Lu Xiangshan; 子靜 is the courtesy name already rendered by Xiangshan convention, not an extra name Jing.

decisions.reason: s0059 微點之狂 pairs with s0060 資由之勇: 點 is Zeng Dian, not a micro-dot; the proposed Dian allusion and 沂上風雩 paraphrase are accurate.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 微點之狂，而有沂上風雩之樂

decisions.reason: The same 微點之狂 requires Dian's wildness in the literal field; micro-dot is a false literalization of 點.
s0092 has 陸子靜 only: 子靜 is the courtesy name (Zijing), already covered by the Xiangshan rendering; trailing Jing is an invented extra name element.
